source_refs.title: Block or allow pop-ups in Chrome
source_refs.section: Manage pop-ups & redirects for a specific site: Block pop-ups and redirects from a site
source_refs.applicability: Chrome on a computer; steps are listed for the computer
source_refs.verified_excerpt: By default, Google Chrome blocks pop-ups from automatically showing up on your screen.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Chrome on a computer: Open Chrome and click More, then Settings. Click Privacy and security, then Site Settings, then Pop-ups and redirects. Under 'Allowed to send pop-ups and use redirects,' find the site. Click More next to the site, then Block. If the site isn't listed, click Add next to 'Not allowed to send pop-ups or use redirects,' enter the site's web address, and then click Add. To cover an entire domain, use the pattern [*.]example.com.

source_refs.section: Manage pop-ups & redirects for a specific site: Allow pop-ups and redirects from a site
source_refs.applicability: Chrome on a computer; the steps begin on a page where pop-ups are blocked
source_refs.verified_excerpt: When a pop-up is blocked, the address bar will be marked Pop-up blocked
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Chrome on a computer: Open Chrome. Go to a page where pop-ups are blocked. In the address bar, click Pop-up blocked. Click the link for the pop-up you want to check. To always allow pop-ups for the site, select Always allow pop-ups and redirects from [site], and then Done.
